Notice Regarding Election Program for Committee Chairperson
In order to conduct the election of the Chairperson for the Parliamentary Hearing Committee and the Committee for Monitoring and Evaluation of the Implementation of State's Directive Principles, Policies, and Responsibilities, formed under the Federal Parliament, the Honorable Speaker has scheduled it for Friday, 2083/01/04, at 1:00 PM. Accordingly, the election program is published as follows.

sections.name: Opening
sections.summary_en: A notice is published regarding the election program for the Chairperson of the Parliamentary Hearing Committee and the Committee for Monitoring and Evaluation of the Implementation of State's Directive Principles, Policies, and Responsibilities. The election is scheduled for Friday, 2083/01/04, at 1:00 PM.
key_issues: State's Directive Principles, Policies, and Responsibilities Monitoring Committee

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The election program details the process for registering proposals for committee chairperson candidates on Thursday, 2083/01/03, between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM. A list of registered proposals will be published at 4:30 PM on the same day. The actual presentation and decision-making on the proposals will occur on Friday, 2083/01/04, starting at 9:00 AM.

sections.name: Adjournment
sections.summary_en: The notice concludes with a signature from Harka Raj Rai, Secretary of the House of Representatives, dated Wednesday, 2083/02/02. A note specifies that a copy of the candidate's photo and citizenship certificate will be attached.
